messages:
kevin: Heads-up — console policy mapping rollout is live in staging. Python SDK clients are dropping route hints because of header normalization we added.

sam: ugh. got an error repro? stack trace?

kevin: minimal repro: server returns header `X-Route-Meta` as list sometimes. python requests lib turns it into a comma string, our sdk expects list. error: `TypeError: expected list`

maria: oh interesting — ts/go treat multi headers differently. We should normalize at the gateway not in sdks.

sam: agree. can we add a server-side shim that always emits JSON in body if multi-values present? cc @devex-bot

devex-bot: FYI: There's a feature flag console.policy.header_normalize in staging

rachel: is this definitely SDK-backwards-incompatible? we try to avoid surprises for self-serve users

kevin: yes. older py sdk (<=1.3.2) will break when it gets "a,b" instead of ["a","b"].

maria: patch idea: SDK change to accept str and split on `,` as temporary tolerance. add telemetry event `header_shim_migration` and a warn log.

sam: would prefer server fix + graceful client fallback. implementing both is fine but need rollouts plan.

kevin: rollout plan: 1) quick server shim behind flag (eng-platform) 2) client tolerant parsing in next minor release 3) console toggle to turn off shim after 2 weeks of telemetry

rachel: telemetry — what metric? counting # of `header_shim_migration` events per SDK version per region.

maria: yep. also track origin (host header) and sample body size to catch edgecases.

sam: ops: can we auto-backfill historical flag events for clients that already saw the header? might be heavy.

srebot: Deploy bot: canary started for shim on staging -> ok. watch: increased 5xx in 10m window

kevin: noted, investigating. sounds like concurrency edge on header parsing in our internal proxy.

maria: if we push client tolerant parsing, add unit test for both `'a,b'` and `['a','b']` and a small comment in changelog advising rollback steps.

rachel: decision: implement server shim behind flag + client tolerant parse in next minor. Devex will craft a quick note for release notes and console banner. @kevin handle shim PR, @maria handle SDK PR, @sam coordinate canary.

kevin: on it. I'll open the shim PR and link here.

sam: thanks. :thumbsup:
